item.text: The issue is localized to four coordinator bounds plus the line-count limit: each currently uses `Number.parseInt` on non-number inputs. I’ll centralize strict coercion so arrays and decorated/scientific/decimal strings fall back, while numeric values and whitespace-wrapped digit strings remain valid.

The strict parser and regression tests are in place, including the zero-timeout case and whitespace-wrapped digits. I’ve also added the required per-change release fragment; now I’m running the focused coordinator test and package typecheck.

- Added regression tests and changelog fragment.
